# Godot RE Tools

Unmodified upstream distribution: GDRETools 2.7.4, Linux x86_64.
Copyright belongs to the GDRETools contributors and included Godot contributors.
License: MIT; see LICENSE and the notices inside the ZIP.

Release and corresponding source:
https://github.com/GDRETools/gdsdecomp/releases/tag/v2.7.4
https://github.com/GDRETools/gdsdecomp/tree/v2.7.4

The shared headless entry point is `python -m tools.godot`. Keep the distribution
ZIP intact. It is unpacked into `<repo>/.cache/engine_tools/gdre/`. No separate Godot editor is needed.
